note: damodaran_monthly values are as of the start of the month and pair with each other: dollar_riskfree_rate with implied_erp_over_dollar_riskfree, or treasury_10y with implied_erp_over_treasury; never mix. Pre-tax cost of debt = treasury_10y + the company's default spread, because rating spreads are measured over Treasuries. fred_latest is the most recent daily close, for checking how far rates moved since.
